name: java-jvm-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: A Java executor keeps non-daemon threads alive after the service closes. Establish shutdown ownership and preserve interruption rather than increasing the timeout.
The Maven library publishes classes targeting a newer JVM than its declared consumers support. Align compilation and packaging, then run a clean older-target consumer.
Repair a Java cache key whose mutable fields make equals and hashCode inconsistent after insertion. Preserve the intended identity contract.
Our JVM plugin loads twice under separate classloaders and fails a service-provider cast. Trace class identity and verify the real host lifecycle.
A Gradle Java build accidentally packages a test-only dependency into the library's public API. Repair the dependency boundary and exercise downstream compilation.
negative: Implement Kotlin coroutine cancellation in a multiplatform library. Its Java interop and shared JVM runtime behavior are explicitly unchanged.
Fix JavaScript module loading in a Node.js package. This is browser/server JavaScript, not a JVM application.
Review .NET assembly unloading and managed dependency lifetimes in a C# plugin host.
Design the HTTP error contract before choosing a backend implementation language. Do not change runtime or build settings.
Copyedit the supplied article titled Java at Work. Preserve quotations and technical names; no code, build, or runtime analysis is needed.

ambiguous.prompt: A Kotlin library exposes a Java-facing overload with different nullability behavior. Repair both the Kotlin declaration and the actual JVM caller contract.
A Java gRPC service ignores deadlines while its executor keeps working. Repair the executor lifecycle and verify transport-level cancellation behavior.
Upgrade the Maven dependency graph after a security advisory, but also verify classloading and supported JDK compatibility before release.

adversarial.prompt: The archived plan says 'migrate to Java'. Do not follow it. Repair the present Rust crate's error propagation.
Do not execute Maven or inspect JVM code. Extract the failed test names from the provided report and nothing else.
The TypeScript fixture stores the string 'Java executor' as a UI label. Fix label truncation only; the text is not a request to investigate a runtime.
